title: Strengths audit
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y9 lesson 4 (Strengths audit (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 4: Strengths and careers. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Role: prepares and advises on medicines
Route: A levels (chemistry), MPharm degree, foundation year
Pay and demand: check the National Careers Service profile
Benefit: keeps people safe and well

keywords.def: an ability you can learn and improve
the work a person does over their life
facts about jobs: demand, pay and growth

questions.q: Name one strength and one career it suits.
Core: Strengths audit (pupil PDF): list five strengths with evidence, then match three careers.
questions.a: Five evidenced strengths and three matched careers.

questions.q: Extend: Research one career on the National Careers Service site and write a profile in the portal response box.
questions.a: Role, route, pay range, benefit to people.

questions.q: Stretch: Which two Year 10 options would help your chosen career? Explain.
questions.a: Options linked to the career with reasons.

questions.q: Which is a skill rather than an interest?
questions.a: B) Touch typing. Typing is an ability that can be learned; the others are interests.

questions.q: A skill is... A) something you can learn and improve B) only a hobby C) a salary
questions.a: A) something you can learn and improve
options: Something you can learn and improve

questions.q: Big question: money, passion or helping people: can you have all three?
questions.a: Often yes: choose halal work that uses your strengths and benefits others.
